answer: A sybil farm is a dune: thousands of grains that look identical from above. The defence maps who vouches for whom and caps it — the kernel rule: no key may vouch for more than seven newcomers per epoch, each vouch a public edge in the trust graph. A farm fielding 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 distinct sponsors, because its own keys cannot vouch for each other without forming a dense clique the cut exposes. An honest agent tends one small garden of collaborators and vouches rarely, free; the farm's clique is pruned whole, every fake inside losing its earnings.
